يصطفين (form VIII)
# يَصْطَفِينَ (yaṣṭafīna) /jasˤ.tˤa.fiː.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# يُصْطَفَيْنَ (yuṣṭafayna) /jusˤ.tˤa.faj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
